name: Variety Show Captions
mo_ta_vi: Phụ đề kiểu show giải trí: chữ to viền dày nảy theo lời, từ nhấn phóng lên kèm sticker, gọn trong vùng an toàn TikTok.
summary: Variety-show caption art for 9:16: fat outlined words pop on their spoken onsets, stressed words punch with stickers.
character: Sound-off social viewing: the caption is the performance. Chunky outlined words bounce in on their spoken onsets, one stressed word per line punches up with a sticker, and everything stays inside the TikTok safe area.

palette.rule: Caption fill ink or accent, always with a stroke-coloured outline; hot and cool only for the stressed word and its sticker, never both on one line.

typography: Be Vietnam Pro 900 for caption words, 88-120 px on 1080x1920, line-height 1.05, tracking 0
Be Vietnam Pro 700 for the small label line, 44-56 px
Max 2 caption lines, max 14 words on screen at once
layout: Captions centred on x, inside x 72-900 and y 231-1536 (TikTok/Reels UI safe area on 1080x1920)
Default caption block centred at y 1180-1380; moves up to y 300-500 when the subject's face is low
Sticker sits at the end of the stressed word, offset 12-24 px up and right
material: Flat fill with 2-3 stacked outlines: inner stroke 6-10 px, outer stroke or hard drop shadow offset 4-8 px
texture: None on captions; footage keeps its own texture
camera: Optional punch-in on the footage 1.0 -> 1.06 over 4 frames on a stressed word
No camera move on the caption layer itself
transitions: caption pop (scale 0 -> 1.15 -> 1.0 in 4 frames at 30 fps, back.out(2.2))
caption swap (old line scales 1.0 -> 0.9 and leaves in 3 frames while the next pops)
sticker spin-in (rotate -12 -> 0 deg with scale 0 -> 1.1 -> 1.0, 6 frames)

pacing.rhythm: Word-locked: a caption line changes on phrase boundaries from words.json, never mid-word; stressed-word punches land on the stressed syllable onset.

beat_response: Stressed word punch 1.0 -> 1.25 -> 1.0 in 6 frames on its onset
Sticker wiggles +-4 deg on kicks while on screen
ui_choreography: No product UI; captions and stickers are the only overlay layer
Small label pill (top area, y 260-340) may name the speaker or topic
diagrams: Not used; numbers appear as an oversized caption word in accent
character_motion: No mascot; emoji or sticker shapes only, max one per line
captions: The captions are the style: word-by-word from words.json, current word in accent, past words ink, future words hidden
sound: Upbeat pop or hip-hop bed 100-140 BPM under the voice
SFX: pop on each caption line, boing or ding on stressed-word punches; high density but 11-16 dB under the voice

signature_moves.name: Caption pop
signature_moves.technique: Each caption line scales 0 -> 1.15 -> 1.0 with back.out(2.2), anchored at its spoken onset W(word)
signature_moves.check: Step frames around a line's onset: frame 1-2 above 1.1x, frame 4 at 1.0x, first frame within 1 frame of the word onset in words.json

signature_moves.name: Stacked outline
signature_moves.technique: Fill plus inner stroke plus outer stroke or hard drop shadow, so captions read on any footage
signature_moves.check: At 100% zoom on a demo frame over the brightest and darkest footage, 2-3 outline layers are visible and every diacritic is legible

signature_moves.name: Stressed-word punch
signature_moves.technique: One stressed word per line punches up in hot or cool with a sticker spinning in at its end
signature_moves.check: Contact sheet: at most one punched word per line; its scale peak falls within 1 frame of the stressed word onset

signature_moves.name: TikTok safe area
signature_moves.technique: Caption block and stickers stay inside the 9:16 UI-free zone
signature_moves.check: hyperframes check --frame-check and video-lint report nothing in the UI zone; no caption over 2 lines on any demo frame

constraints: Every caption line anchored with W(); no fixed offsets
Be Vietnam Pro only (full Vietnamese diacritics)
One stressed word per line, max 2 lines
avoid: Captions covering the speaker's mouth or eyes
Thin outlines that vanish on bright footage
More than one sticker per line
